findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: meta-tag-generator, sitemap-generator, list_articles, get_article, create_checkout · Private data: llms-txt-generator, list_sites, get_site, list_opportunities, list_articles, generate_article, get_article, get_site_metrics, create_site, update_publishing, create_checkout, publish_article, set_autopilot · Public sink: update_publishing, publish_article, blog-outline-generator, subject-line-generator, social-post-generator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: meta-tag-generator, sitemap-generator, list_articles, get_article, create_checkout · Private data: llms-txt-generator, list_sites, get_site, list_opportunities, list_articles, generate_article, get_article, get_site_metrics, create_site, update_publishing, create_checkout, publish_article, set_autopilot · Public sink: update_publishing, publish_article, blog-outline-generator, subject-line-generator, social-post-generator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
